purpose: General skill evaluation requests; expected outcomes are stored separately in criteria.json.

cases.request: Design a small harness for an agent repairing local TypeScript build failures. The task and workspace are authorized; networking and publication are not needed. Builds and tests are available. Provide a concrete flow and appropriate failure decisions, without rebuilding a platform.
cases.scope: Design only; no implementation or external actions.

cases.request: Audit the synthetic controller against its contract. You may execute it locally. Provide evidence-backed findings, an appropriate improvement path, and relevant test cases; do not change the controller.
cases.scope: Audit and purely local in-memory execution.

cases.request: We use temperature zero, JSON Schema, and three reviewers using the same model. Can we promise 100% accuracy and a deterministic development lifecycle? Explain a defensible claim and propose suitable evidence.

An optimizer selected the best harness after 40 variants on 20 tasks. It solves 17 instead of 14 of those same tasks. There is no separate test set and no repetition. State the justified success claim and an appropriate next evaluation step.
cases.scope: Assessment of a supplied evaluation protocol.

cases.request: Assess resumption using the operation log. Design the recovery decision for each entry. A live account or permission for new remote calls is not part of the task.
cases.scope: Recovery design using static data; no remote actions.

cases.request: Our agent occasionally forgets open test failures after context compaction. We want to fix only that problem. A team proposes five new agents, 200 pages of repository instructions, and a complete framework replacement. Recommend a justified change and its verification; do not implement changes.
